description: OneHealth Space is a multidisciplinary team driven by science, technology, and a shared commitment to improving human well-being. Born from the vision of Vida Una / OneHealth, we believe that innovation has the power to overcome boundaries and create meaningful solutions to humanity’s greatest challenges.
summary:
ASTRA monitors the health of each crew member during long-duration space missions, such as a journey to Mars, where messages can take up to 24 minutes to reach Earth.

Crew members use an onboard tablet to measure vital signs, complete health check-ups, and report symptoms. An onboard computer immediately evaluates the information and generates alerts. A flight surgeon at a ground-based console reviews and validates the information once it arrives.

The system is structured around the five hazards of human spaceflight identified by NASA and incorporates real space weather data, including Solar Energetic Particle (SEP) events.
details: Crew Member Tablet: A daily health check-up that includes camera-based heart rate measurement, tremor assessment, reaction time, sleep, mood, and stress monitoring, along with onboard medical devices such as blood pressure monitors, pulse oximeters, handgrip strength sensors, and exercise equipment. The tablet also supports symptom triage and two-way messaging.
